query:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (
                   WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND dead_at IS NULL
               )                                          AS "pending!",
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE dead_at IS NOT NULL) AS "dead!",
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - min(enqueued_at) FILTER (
                   WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND dead_at IS NULL
               ))::BIGINT                                  AS backlog_age_seconds
          FROM outbox
